get.description: Return a page of the messages Ren saved for the session, newest first, as `session.messages` in the Chat API does. Follow `cursor.next` for older messages. Read this while `chat.access` returns `starting` or `failed`. A staged revert hides its messages. `413` means the page is too large: ask for a smaller `limit`. `503` means Ren is busy: ask again after `retryAfterMs`.

post.description: Start the session’s brain again after `chat.access` returned `failed`, and start the session with `message` as its first message. A session that already started ignores `message`.
Start waking the brain of a space whose chats share one brain, so a new chat there starts faster. Call it when someone begins a new chat. Ren wakes each brain at most once per 5 minutes.

Task.Actor.description: Who acted: a person, an agent in a session on a person’s behalf, or the system when every field is null.

Task.AgentSession.description: The latest session of the task’s agent on this task.

agentId.description: The new agent, or null for none.

ownerId.description: The new owner, or null for none.

spaceId.description: Moves the task and its subtasks to this space. An owner who is not a member of the space is cleared, and so is a subtask’s agent that the space cannot use. A subtask moves only with its parent.

note.description: The instruction for the receiving agent. The trail keeps it; the description stays.

start.description: Whether to start the agent. The default is `continue` when the agent changes, else `none`.

agentId.description: The agent that has the task. Creating never starts it.

ownerId.description: The person responsible for the task.

parentId.description: Makes the task a subtask of this task, which must be in the same space and not be a subtask itself.

subtasks.description: Null when the task has no live subtasks.

start.description: Whether to continue the agent’s latest session with the decision. Without it, Ren’s default applies.

Task.ReviewInput.description: Turn human review on, with the reason a person must act, or off, with a person’s decision. Only a person turns it off.

Task.StartMode.description: `new` opens a new session for the task’s agent. `continue` resumes the agent’s latest session on this task, or opens one when there is none.

Task.Status.description: The state of the whole task, never of one agent. `todo`: no one started it. `in_progress`: the work started and is not finished; a handoff keeps it. `done`: finished. `dismissed`: no one will do it; it stays readable so that it is not suggested again. Only a person sets `done` or `dismissed`.

Task.Subtasks.description: The task’s live subtasks: `done` of `total`. Dismissed subtasks count in neither.

removeLinks.description: Links to remove, by ID or by URL.

parentId.description: Makes the task a subtask of this task, which must be in the same space and not be a subtask itself. Null makes it a task of its own. A task that has subtasks cannot become one.

Task.UpdateInput.description: Change the task’s content. Assignment has its own action, `assign`.

retryAfterMs.description: Ask again after this many milliseconds.

bearer.description: A Better Auth session token, for the CLI and SDK.
